seatRail.label: Clients
seatRail.switchWhileGeneratingBody: Switching seats aborts and discards the running response. Switch anyway?

authority.notConfirmedYet: This setting came from an older version and you never confirmed it. Have a look.
authority.ladderDescription: One rung. It governs the everyday decisions — not the delicate ones below.
authority.sealsTitle: What EVE may only do with explicit permission
authority.sealsDescription: These five hang off no rung. Even on “Full” they stay off until you switch each one on.
authority.budgetMissing: Without an amount EVE spends nothing
authority.budgetHigh: That is a high daily amount. It is saved — please check you did not mistype.

watch.title: Watch only
watch.body: EVE reads, thinks along and suggests. It changes nothing, not even what you granted.

ask.title: Ask me
ask.body: EVE asks before every change. You see each step before it happens.

routine.title: Routine
routine.body: EVE reads and writes inside your workspace. For commands it asks.

work.title: Working
work.body: Plus routine commands: tests, builds, read-only git.

independent.title: Independent
independent.body: Plus everything reversible, including outside the workspace.

full.title: Full
full.body: Plus irreversible work. The five below still stay off.

money.title: Spend money
money.body: Paid models and services — up to the amount you set here.

publish.title: Publish and send
publish.body: Emails, posts, anything that reaches other people.

delete.title: Delete outside the workspace
delete.body: Touch files that do not belong to the project.

credentials.title: Read credentials
credentials.body: See secrets and keys in clear text.

authority.rememberedDescription: Commands you allowed permanently for this seat. EVE stops asking for them — until you withdraw one here.
authority.rememberedEmpty: Nothing remembered yet. EVE asks for every command.
